## lint.run [#lint.run]

**Lint.** Runs the grammar linter on slides in the static, rendered or both layers and returns findings.

| Field      | Type                             | Required | Description         |
| ---------- | -------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------- |
| `slideIds` | "all" \| string[]                | yes      | Slide ids, or 'all' |
| `layers`   | "static" \| "rendered" \| "both" | no       |                     |
| `rule`     | one of 56 values                 | no       |                     |

- Command line: `turboslide lint <slideIds> --json`
- MCP tool: `deck_lint`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/lint.run`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: no.

## fix.run [#fix.run]

**Fix.** Applies the fix mutations of findings that carry one and reports what remains.

| Field          | Type              | Required | Description                                                      |
| -------------- | ----------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slideIds`     | "all" \| string[] | yes      | Slide ids, or 'all'                                              |
| `rule`         | one of 56 values  | no       |                                                                  |
| `dryRun`       | boolean           | no       |                                                                  |
| `baseRevision` | integer           | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409 |

- Command line: `turboslide fix <slideIds> --rule <rule> --dry-run`
- MCP tool: `deck_fix`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/fix.run`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## judge.bundle [#judge.bundle]

**Judge bundle.** Packages renders, sheets with cell maps, render records and findings into a directory for a judge run.

| Field      | Type              | Required | Description         |
| ---------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------- |
| `slideIds` | "all" \| string[] | yes      | Slide ids, or 'all' |
| `out`      | string            | yes      |                     |

- Command line: `turboslide judge bundle --out <out>`
- MCP tool: `deck_judge_bundle`
- HTTP: No HTTP endpoint.
- Runs on: command line, MCP.
- Changes the presentation: no.
